topic: Memory Hierarchy and Caching Strategies: CPU-Main Gap
explanation: Modern computer systems utilize a memory hierarchy to bridge the speed gap between CPU and main memory.  This hierarchy consists of multiple levels of storage with varying speeds and capacities.  Caching strategies determine how data is moved between these levels to optimize performance.  Effective caching minimizes the time the CPU spends waiting for data, significantly impacting overall system speed.
